NEWSANGUO_CHARACTER_CAO_WEI_CHARACTER.de: A world being eroded by Heaven's Decay.
NEWSANGUO_CHARACTER_CAO_WEI_CHARACTER.ca: Cao Wei cards will now appear in rewards and shops.
NEWSANGUO_CHARACTER_CAO_WEI_CHARACTER.ev: My time has not yet come!
NEWSANGUO_CHARACTER_CAO_WEI_CHARACTER.un: This character is available from the start.
NEWSANGUO_CHARACTER_CAO_WEI_CHARACTER.ar: [sine]...This scent—like aged wine, and like freshly spilled blood. The Mandate of Heaven is about to change.[/sine]
NEWSANGUO_CHARACTER_CAO_WEI_CHARACTER.go: [sine]This heap of gold... enough to trade for a city's worth of wine, enough to drink until the three kingdoms become one.[/sine]
NEWSANGUO_CHARACTER_CAO_WEI_CHARACTER.ba: Hold on! Let me raise a grand toast first, then we go again!
I'll lie here a while. You all keep fighting.
NEWSANGUO_CHARACTER_SHU_HAN_CHARACTER.ca: Shu Han cards will now appear in rewards and shops.
NEWSANGUO_CHARACTER_SHU_HAN_CHARACTER.un: This character is available from the start.
NEWSANGUO_CHARACTER_SHU_HAN_CHARACTER.ar: [sine]...This scent—like freshly brewed wine, and like a banner newly raised. Where benevolence goes, hearts follow.[/sine]
NEWSANGUO_CHARACTER_SHU_HAN_CHARACTER.go: [sine]This gold... enough to arm an army, enough to buy a city's worth of wine.[/sine]
NEWSANGUO_CHARACTER_SHU_HAN_CHARACTER.ba: One moment—let me drain this cup, then we go again!
I'll rest a while. Carry on, all of you.
